description: Iteration 1: keep Saval car-following values, lower red running and switch on early start and sparse space seeking to match observed shares.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Targets M1/car (discharge headway 0.387 s) and M6/approach car times: Saval Table 11 car values kept unchanged because no feedback yet shows a car metric off; cars stop at red (M3/share/car 0.0027).
Targets M9a/M9b (straight cars in the right-turn lane, 0.33 veh/cycle): same car values as car_saval so it only differs through queue_space_seeking; 10% share kept so the rare event rate stays small.

Targets M1/moto (headway 0.30 s), M4/overshoot_share (0.63) and M5/moto_density: Saval motorcycle values with the smallest allowed lateral gap 0.3 m so riders pack densely at the stop line; unchanged pending feedback.

Targets M10a (0.27 sidewalk motorcycles per cycle) and M9a: motorcycle values identical to moto_saval so only the space-seeking rule makes it differ; 10% share gives a few riders per cycle able to seek space.
Targets M7a/n_waiting (5.5 veh) and M7b/clear_lag (6.65 s): same riders as moto_saval; jmTimegapMinor kept at the 1.0 s default because the box release is not yet shown to be too early or too late.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M3/share/moto (0.092), M3/per_cycle (4.4) and M3/var_to_mean (1.31): p0 = 0.5 applies to every stopline arrival and likely overshoots 0.092, so p0 is lowered to 0.15; a small k = 0.05 with cap 0.3 adds group clustering, raising the variance/mean above 1.

Targets M2/early/moto (0.13 share, lead 4-10 s) and M2/first_delay (2.1 s): p = 0.15 per front-row rider approximates the observed early-start share; creep window 6 s sits mid-range and 2.5 m/s is slow rolling, which also shortens the first crossing delay.

Targets F2/p/right_lane/q20-40 (0.031), F2/p/sidewalk/q20-40 (0.016), M9a (0.33/cycle) and M10a (0.27/cycle): trigger queue q = 20 m since observed choices occur at 13 m queues and none above 40 m; p_right_lane 0.03 and p_sidewalk 0.02 match the observed probabilities; p_wrong_lane stays 0 because it is inapplicable on the proxy net (R27).
